title: The Failure Test
findings: The author describes a brief breach of support or resistance followed by a reversal back across it. The long case tests below support and closes above it.
The stop belongs at or beyond the failure movement extreme; for the long case this is the signal low. Adverse gaps can exceed nominal stop risk.

This implementation selects the previous completed UTC day as support, next-open entry, the existing peer/context filters, 2R target, 64-bar timeout and shared-cash sizing as explicit NEXUS research extensions. The source does not supply those choices.

coverage.entry: Downside support test and completed-close recovery; support construction and execution timing are research choices.
coverage.exit: Long-side invalidation is the low of the failure movement. Target and timeout are research choices.
